input: A frozen k-3..k+4 local power window clipped at RAW limits, count2..8, bracket offset0..3, RAW index0..16382, threshold/noise and direction; at least4 points required for valid fitting
output: Same FixedEdge Q16 indices and unsigned64 Q32 variances as fine_fixed.edge_pair_q16; first/last crossing search, source and SNR policy are outside this service

arithmetic.front_end: signed48 OLS slope/intercept/numerator, signed64 residual/Z terms with physically bounded unsigned32 power<=2^31
arithmetic.wide_unit: FAST_MATH=0 legacy serial unsigned256; active fine_engine selects FAST_MATH=1 exact carry-select add/sub, pipelined32x32 multiply, bit-serial divider
arithmetic.rounding: nonnegative quotient nearest with exact half upward; equivalent to frozen edge ratio half-away-from-zero after sign normalization
arithmetic.variance: exact integer numerator/denominator form, no floating point, reciprocal approximation or covariance-policy change; unsigned64 Q32 min1LSB, overflow invalidates
arithmetic.microcode: 62 instructions generated by tools/fine_edge_program.py, checked against generated SV package
arithmetic.full_engine_dsp_budget: Current whole fine_engine synthesis uses48DSP, including edge, two-sample statistics and FINALIZE; see docs/v06_fine_integration.md
arithmetic.historical_resource_scope: resource_measured below belongs to the prior committed serial candidate source only; current complete engine synthesis supersedes it for acceptance

latency.units: cycles from accepted request to result_valid, excluding held-result backpressure
latency.candidate_model: fine_edge_program.candidate_reference returns exact latency; all320 numerical cases compare both data and cycles
latency.scope: Historical cycle equations and bounds apply only to FAST_MATH=0. Active FAST_MATH=1 is checked against the same exact320 numeric vectors; actual full-job and three-range workload timings are recorded in the integration evidence, not inferred from this historical service bound.

lifecycle: one outstanding candidate; hold all result fields until ready; rst/abort cancel front-end and shared arithmetic; input latched once
quality: NO_RISE/NO_FALL, FLAT_EDGE, RINGING|INSUFFICIENT_LOCAL_DATA, INSUFFICIENT_LOCAL_DATA, BAD_SOURCE for invalid power/prior, VARIANCE_OVERFLOW; invalid output fields zero
